title: Newport Helicopter Tours

services.name: On Watch Sailing
services.desc: Experience the thrill of flight with a one of a kind sunset helicopter tour. Get a truly unique perspective of this amazing island, from the awe of the Elms, Marble House and the Breaker’s to one of the country’s most beautiful coastline along Ocean Drive. Pair these amazing sites with the perfect sunset from above. Includes an Inflight Video of your experience - with cockpit conversations and music - outside views . Limited availability to Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays. Take control of your adventure with a fully customizable 60-minute helicopter tour over Rhode Island. services.name: Helicopter Safety
services.desc: Our helicopter of choice is a Robinson R-44 Raven I. It’s unmatched reliability, speed, and exceptional visibility from all seats made using the R-44 the clear choice. We have added several options to ensure the highest level of safety. The aircraft has a bright viper red paint scheme for exceptional visibility to other aircraft. A pulsating LED landing light system was also added. We use Traffic Information System (TIS) equipment, a system that displays air traffic on a moving GPS map to the pilot, just like an air traffic control radar display. services.name: Our Charters
services.desc: Birds Eye View Helicopter Charters offers private, luxury helicopter travel throughout New England. Skip the traffic and arrive in style with seamless, on-demand service designed around your schedule. Our most popular destinations include Montauk, Martha’s Vineyard, Nantucket, and Boston - connecting you quickly and comfortably to the region’s most sought-after coastal escapes and city hubs. Whether you’re traveling for business, a weekend getaway, or a special occasion, Birds Eye View delivers a safe, efficient, and unforgettable flight experience - because the journey should be just as exceptional as the destination.
